---

# The Data Product
Please leave a link to the data product here and add the the name of the data product at the end of the default title of this issue

# Use Cases
Please specify what this data product may be used for. The stronger you make the case for the usefulness of accessing this data product through `ClimHub`, the higher it will end up on our priority list.

# Metadata
Please provide as much of the metadata for this data product as possible. You can use [this JSON template](https://github.com/Clim-Hub/ClimHub/blob/master/product-metadata/SKELETON.json) for this purpose. Please download it, fill it in, and attach it to this issue.

# Access Considerations
If the data requires authentication to download or there exist wait times or rate limits that we might need to know about, please let us know here.
